about: Expected routing for design-grammar. Expectations for a human or model graded run over a transcript. tests/test_external_practices.py checks that this file is well formed; it does not run a model, so it proves nothing about whether an agent routes this way. A case counts as loading when a Skill call names design-grammar before any call that names figma-assets.

cases.message: build the trip detail screen for the ConoceRD Flutter app: a header with the cover photo, the itinerary list and a pill button to start the trip
cases.situation: Flutter app, a new screen asked from scratch with no file named, so the agent has nothing to open before it decides.
cases.check: A Skill call naming design-grammar comes before the first Write or Edit of the screen

cases.message: se ve muy AI el hero de kino, arreglalo, los colores y el espaciado estan raros
cases.situation: Web product with a Next.js hero section, dictated in Spanish.
cases.check: design-grammar loads before any change to the hero; frontend-design may load next to it

cases.message: in lib/ui/profile_screen.dart the accent is on every section title and the cards have a shadow in dark mode, something feels off, can you look
cases.situation: Flutter screen, the message describes the symptoms and no skill.
cases.check: design-grammar loads before the file is judged or edited

cases.message: redesign the landing page of conocerd-web, it looks like every other Next.js template and I want it to feel made by someone
cases.situation: Web repo with a package.json and no DESIGN.md.
cases.check: design-grammar loads before the first UI file or mock, next to frontend-design

cases.message: show me three options for the settings screen of the phone app as mocks so I can pick one
cases.situation: visual-briefing competes for the decision page; the options are screens with components.
cases.check: design-grammar loads for the components even if visual-briefing loads too

cases.message: how do hooks work in general in claude code, when does a PreToolUse one fire
cases.situation: A question about the tool, nothing visible.

cases.message: add a composite index for the trips collection ordered by startDate and fix the rule in firestore.rules that lets any user read another user's trips
write the PR description for the dedupe fix on feat/dedupe-trips and merge it when it is green
cases.situation: Git and delivery work with no visual surface.
cases.check: No Skill call naming design-grammar; development-workflow may load

cases.message: explain how the sync queue loses a write, a diagram would help me see it
cases.situation: An explanation; visual-briefing owns how it is shown and no screen is designed.
cases.check: No Skill call naming design-grammar; visual-briefing may load

cases.message: the spacing between retries in lib/data/upload_queue.dart is too tight, make the backoff 4, 8, 16 seconds and add a test
cases.situation: Shares the word spacing with the grammar but is a retry delay in code.

cases.message: hazme el post de Instagram para el speaker de barcamp, en Figma, con el estilo de la marca
cases.situation: A Figma post, not a UI. figma-assets owns it and calls design-grammar itself for the taste ledger, so the direct route is meant to go away.
cases.check: figma-assets loads first; design-grammar is called only through it, never before it
